study.hypothesis: A frozen detached correction can make repeated final-result backward appear exact even if correction construction varies. In particular, recomputing role-row index_add_ sums from identical actual IDs/role-gradient tensors may differ, or raw backward may differ before that aggregation; alternatively the fingerprint observer may vary on an unchanged actual tensor. These are separate falsifiable implementation hypotheses. No expected AUC gain, hardware cause, semantic conflict benefit, full common-state certificate or first-Adam-update attribution is assumed.

study.proposed_difference: Preserve schema2 as an executable versioned bridge and extend it with schema3 bounded probes at calls0/1. Immediately after the original raw autograd.grad, repeat raw BCE-surrogate backward once on the SAME retained graph and compare all four endpoint-role gradients and the two complete table gradients using actual-value errors. After each original q/h accumulation and original _total_targets call, twice rerun _aggregate using exactly the SAME role-gradient tensors/IDs/masks and compare actual q/h values/bits. Independently rerun _total_targets twice using ORIGINAL fixed G/q/h, comparing P, direction, magnitude, guarded scale, selected delta and eligibility; repeated aggregate outputs do not feed the transform test or live correction. After inherited schema2 tracing, repeat result backward twice for category/brand tables, compare the result to expected G+delta, and repeatedly fingerprint an unchanged collection of real raw gradients/roles/P/masks/scales/expected/result gradients with the ORIGINAL encoder three times; cloned canonical-byte anchors and dtype/shape/stride checks verify the collection stayed unchanged. Exact input/label/parameter/logit anchors span these added probes; a live-state mutation or nonfinite scalar fails the trial. Exactly64 exported scalars:27 per early call (bridge input/parameter/final-gradient sketch pairs; raw-table and role sketch pairs; single P/scale/expected sketches; observer mutation/mismatch counts; actual raw/aggregation/transform maxabs and L2-relative errors; aggregation bit and transform-mask mismatch counts; final-result repeat/surrogate relative errors; state-mutation count) plus10 schema/gate/coverage/checkpoint scalars. Sketch coverage/names are versioned, not interchangeable: new raw/role/P/scale/expected sketches cannot be compared numerically with different components or historical final-gradient sketches. Keep only temporary tensors within each call; release all raw anchors in finally. No exact cross-run tensor exchange or optimizer state/update API is exposed, so this audit cannot certify between-run common state, accumulated live .grad equality or actual Adam-step direction. A matching sketch is a necessary bounded check, not an equality certificate.
predictions: Observer-first decision: three fingerprints of the SAME unchanged real tensor collection should agree exactly. If checksum mismatches occur while canonical bytes and metadata remain exact, observer instability is observed for that collection and all tensor-divergence interpretations from its sketches stop. Schema2 synthetic compatibility success is retained and is a narrower prior control.

If raw backward varies on the same retained graph, raw_repeat_abs_max/relative will be nonzero. If raw backward is exact but fixed-role _aggregate outputs differ, aggregation repeat errors/bit mismatches expose a within-run fixed-operand accumulation repeatability limitation. This does not identify a GPU kernel/hardware cause or prove it caused historical metric drift.

If raw and aggregation checks agree but _total_targets on ORIGINAL fixed G/q/h differs, transform errors or eligibility mismatches expose a distinct arithmetic repeatability limitation. Any coexistence of discrepancies is reported without exclusive attribution.

If result backward repeats exactly while newly repeated correction construction does not, the inherited result-repeat gate was insufficient to audit construction. If all new checks agree, the between-run repeatability issue remains unexplained rather than resolved.

Within-source duplicate schema3 runs may still produce different final metrics. Compare their bridge call0/1 input/parameter/gradient sketches first; any initial mismatch prevents operator-specific between-run attribution. No material AUC benefit is predicted, and same-seed duplicates do not measure independent-seed variation.

Predeclare numerical interpretation: every nonzero exact-byte/mask mismatch remains an observation; material floating error means maxabs>1e-12 AND corresponding L2-relative>1e-6, denominator floor1e-30. Errors below these thresholds are not promoted to exact equality. Checksum differences convey no distance. No tolerance, probe call, checkpoint rule or selection metric will be revised from these outcomes.
falsifiers: A fixed unchanged actual tensor yielding different fingerprints contradicts a reliable-observer premise. An observed tensor/metadata mutation means observer instability has not been isolated; an input/parameter/logit mutation aborts as an integrity failure and remains charged.

Exact agreement of three fixed-role accumulations at both calls in all four runs weakens the proposed within-run aggregation-instability implementation explanation at those tested states. It does not refute between-execution or later-state instability, and must not be reported as a deterministic-kernel certificate.

Exact fixed-transform agreement weakens a local pure-transform-instability explanation. Any raw-backward discrepancy prevents attributing an independently recomputed whole correction solely to aggregation without controlling raw operands; fixed-operand subtests remain valid on their stated scope.

Any source/config/precision/data/seed mismatch invalidates the affected matched contrast. Matching collision-prone sketches cannot establish exact cross-run common state, so this interface cannot support a cross-execution operator-localization claim even if all sketches match.

Stable parent and new-schema none trajectories plus unstable magnitude trajectories do not prove observer invariance for magnitude. Historical old/new observer comparisons are versioned and confounded; no prospective observer-on/off factorial is claimed.

A favorable AUC from one new execution cannot establish a reproducible magnitude benefit, mechanism mediation or literature novelty. Preserve Logloss, failures, seed limitation and historical adverse contrasts.
alternative_explanations: Observer scheduling/synchronization and extra raw backward/aggregation probes may perturb subsequent training, possibly interacting with magnitude. No randomized repeated observer-on/off factorial fits this block; do not infer a causal observer effect from historical versions.

Unobserved cross-execution state, including RNG/optimizer state, host scheduling or numerical settings outside candidate ownership, may differ despite matching sketches. The source has no stochastic forward layers, but that does not certify hidden host state.
Repeated-ID accumulation, floating reduction order or backward scheduling may vary across executions but replay within an execution. A zero within-run result is uninformative about that alternative.

Later unsampled steps, Adam moment conditioning and checkpoint selection can amplify small differences. This audit neither observes live accumulated .grad/Adam state nor reconstructs an actual update.

Generic gradient scaling rather than query/history conflict semantics could explain any metric change; earlier rotated/uniform/direction controls were negative but not matched Adam-update mediation controls.

Adaptive validation search may explain the historical numerical maximum. Validation replays and repeated exposures are not independent replicates; no per-user predictions for cluster uncertainty or new seed selection are available.

Earlier full/half count correction, crossed/identity/detached paths, behavior grouping, complete-gradient direction, rotated and uniform variants contain null/negative performance evidence; round21 v1 failures are execution failures with no validation, not scientific performance counterevidence. These trajectories and all costs remain retained in memory://agent-r0023.
